reasons: DeepSeek authored only 2 of 4 required DOCX deliverables.
Luna High timed out after emitted content and completed tool calls, so its retry was ineligible.
The preregistered tool hash described an OpenAI Responses serialization rather than either lane's exact model-facing transport surface.
The Luna performer source closure omitted the Codex CLI and MCP bridge implementation actually used.

luna.inference_surface: Codex CLI authenticated through the user's subscription

upstream_primary_forensics.role: mechanism evidence only; not a newly preregistered pass cell
upstream_primary_forensics.trajectory: The first authoring batch made four create calls; two succeeded and two failed. Because upstream authoring was nonterminal, a follow-up round made two more create calls and completed the missing files.

causal_assessment.finding: Terminal authoring is causally implicated in the multi-deliverable failure.
causal_assessment.strength: direct code-path and same-task trajectory evidence
evidence: The primary upstream baseline was nonterminal and recovered after a partial authoring batch.
Frozen v5 was terminal and stopped after 1 of 4 deliverables.
Final v1 was terminal and stopped after 2 of 4 deliverables despite complete body-evidence coverage and zero failed calls.
causal_assessment.limit: This establishes a completion-contract defect, not a quality win for any successor arm.

defects.finding: The preregistration called the OpenAI Responses-format hash the exact tool schema hash. DeepSeek instead sent the OpenAI Chat Completions wrapper array unchanged; Codex translated the same source schemas into MCP list_tools objects.
defects.impact: Exact lane-specific model-facing bytes were not fail-closed even though names, descriptions, parameters, and live core prompt were frozen.

defects.finding: The live system receipt hashed the inner Beaver system prompt, but the Codex CLI performer prepended buildCodexPrompt instructions and labels that were not separately preregistered or receipted.
defects.impact: The independent Luna product side-run had an unreceipted model-visible prompt envelope.

defects.finding: The MCP bridge added generic server instructions naming A2AJ, CourtListener, workflow, and connector operations even though the frozen resident surface exposed only five coding/document tools.
defects.impact: Unavailable-domain language leaked into the independently labelled Luna product surface.

defects.finding: The preregistered source fingerprints included codexApi.ts, but the performer dispatch used index.ts, codex.ts, and codexToolBridge.ts; those actual performer files were omitted.
defects.impact: The Luna implementation closure was not frozen by the registration.

surface_audit.conclusion: No task, rubric, benchmark, ablation, fixed-count, receipt, body-evidence, or signal-gate terminology was found in the final v1 core prompt/tool text. Nevertheless, exact transport-surface provenance failed closed only semantically, not byte-exactly, and the Codex product wrapper contained unrelated-domain instructions.

successor_hypothesis.preserve: All final v1 retrieval, evidence-plane, one-shot signal-gate, source-immutability, draft-only Edit, exact-figure, shadow-check, and deliverable-integrity behavior.
successor_hypothesis.treatment_delta: Set terminal authoring off for the candidate so successful create receipts return to the model and remaining deliverables can be completed, matching the primary upstream baseline's completion semantics.
successor_hypothesis.luna_infrastructure_delta: Make the local Codex exec watchdog configurable; retain the production 180000 ms default and preregister 600000 ms for Luna High.
surface_provenance_delta: Preregister and live-validate the exact DeepSeek Chat Completions tool array hash.
Preregister and live-validate the exact Codex prompt envelope, MCP list_tools objects, and MCP server instructions.
Fingerprint the actual Codex CLI performer dispatch and bridge files.
Replace the Codex MCP bridge's unavailable-domain inventory with a neutral instruction scoped to the tools actually served.
successor_hypothesis.prompt_delta: No fixed document count, benchmark term, task-specific parser, or experimental instruction.
successor_hypothesis.next_inference: None until explicit user approval and a fresh preregistration.
